audit_relayed: Independent audit of APG-MIE-1.1 (ZIP SHA-256 0d2d158c47d5208dfbc3f19a2ad1a75ebed288e038e463241b841ea1de171b4b), relayed by the product owner on 2026-10-20; the product owner and the auditor agreed to record it in the programme registers
what_the_auditor_reproduced: The probe tools/probe_mie1_audit_findings.py on the delivered MIE-1 ZIP (17 of 18 cases defective; the control passed) and on MIE-1.1 (0 of 18). The ten correction tests pass on MIE-1.1 and fail or error on MIE-1. Unexpected commit errors fail closed with the failure audit attempted; audit-sink failures are treated as unavailable; observation batches use an all-or-nothing store call. Sabotage cases C-01 to C-05 (and all 70 cases) were caught.
what_is_not_independently_verified: The full 624-mutant run (624 changes, 621 killed, 3 documented equivalents, 0 survivors) is builder-reported: the auditor ran selected mutants only, which were killed. The full whole-suite command R12 timed out in the auditor's environment; the counted groups 9 to 19 (2,528 tests) passed separately.
what_this_does_not_mean: It does not accept the MIE-1.1 release, make it production-ready or integrate it with the Anchor Engine. The host-side contracts EDR-36, EDR-37 and EDR-38 are unverified on any real store, and the core cannot undo a write a real store has committed before raising an exception. BLK-01 to BLK-03, M7.3 final acceptance, the M9.4 comparison and the development deviation DEV-MIE-01 stay open (CF-36 to CF-39).
